# Reonomy

> Reonomy is an AI-powered commercial real estate (CRE) property intelligence platform that provides access to 54M+ properties with machine learning-driven insights, property data APIs, and predictive analytics for deal sourcing and investment decisions.

Reonomy, owned by Altus Group, combines comprehensive property data, ownership information, and transaction history with machine learning to help CRE professionals unlock market intelligence. The platform offers both a web application for interactive property search and APIs for data integration.

## Key Topics

- Commercial Real Estate (CRE)
- Property Intelligence

- Machine Learning

## Core Products

- [Reonomy - Unlock CRE Property Intelligence](https://www.reonomy.com): Reonomy homepage showcasing AI-powered CRE property intelligence platform
- [Reonomy Web Application - Property Intelligence, Property Search, Property Data & Property Records](https://www.reonomy.com/i/solutions/web-application-v1): Reonomy web app for property search, records, and commercial real estate deals
- [Reonomy Data & API Solutions - Property Data API & Property Data Feeds](https://www.reonomy.com/solutions/data-solutions): Data solutions including Property Data API and feeds for CRE data integration
